enabled.description: Whether to enable the IP-over-IP daemon at boot.

tun_prefix.description: Prefix for dynamically created tunnel interface names (e.g., ipip0, ipip1).

local_addr.description: Local IPv4 address to use as the source for outgoing IP-in-IP encapsulated packets. Leave empty to auto-detect.

mtu.description: Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) for tunnel interfaces. Typical value is 1480 to account for IP header overhead.

log_to_syslog.description: Whether to send daemon log messages to the system logger (syslog).

tunnels.description: List of IP-over-IP tunnels to configure.

name.description: Unique identifier for the tunnel (used in variable names and logs).

local_ip.description: Local endpoint IPv4 address (or FQDN resolved to IPv4) for this tunnel.

remote_ip.description: Remote endpoint IPv4 address (must be reachable via unicast IPv4 routing).

local_gw.description: Local gateway IP (if different from auto-detected route). Typically not needed.

remote_gw.description: Next-hop gateway to reach remote_ip (advanced; usually omitted).

description.description: Human-readable description for documentation or UI purposes.

enabled.description: Enable/disable this specific tunnel without removing its config.
